name: Tacos
intro: Corn tortillas, a protein, and September's jars. The meal this month does best.

proteins.name: Mahi-mahi
proteins.timing: Seared 3–4 minutes without moving, flipped, 2–3 more. Flaked in the pan.

proteins.name: Chicken thighs, from the salsa verde pot

steps.text: Warm the tortillas directly over a flame or in a dry pan until they blister in spots. Stack them under a towel.
Cook or warm your protein. Mahi: salt it, pat it dry, sear without moving until it lets go of the pan, then flip.
Your flavor, cilantro, and lime last.

leftovers: Leftover fish or chicken goes into tomorrow's rice bowl.
